👤 PRIMARY CREATOR PERSONA
Head of Cloud FinOps & Enterprise Cloud Economist

Responsible for establishing unit economics KPIs, Kubecost pod-level cost allocation rules, Vertex AI prompt/completion token pricing models, and CUD commitment strategies.

👔 PRIMARY CONSUMER PERSONA
CFO, VP of Finance & Business Unit General Managers

Reviews monthly departmental chargeback invoices, tracks cloud spend vs forecast budgets, and approves committed use discount (CUD) multi-year contracts.

🚀 BIG TECH & ENGINEERING PERSPECTIVE (Google / Uber / Stripe)
1. Microservice & AI Unit Economics: Tracks cost-per-query, cost-per-token, and cost-per-active-user in real-time, giving engineering squads direct accountability for architectural efficiency.

2. Automated Tagging CI/CD Linter: Terraform pull requests automatically fail CI gates if infrastructure manifests lack mandatory owner, environment, and cost-center metadata tags.

3. Real-Time Anomaly Interception: BigQuery ML detects spending anomalies within 15 minutes of runaway Cloud Run or Vertex AI job triggers, firing automated Cloud Monitoring webhooks.

💼 TIER-1 STRATEGY CONSULTING PERSPECTIVE (McKinsey / BCG / Bain)
1. Cultural Transformation from IT Cost Center to Profit Engine: Replaces opaque shared infrastructure overhead with 100% transparent departmental chargeback, aligning cloud spend directly with business P&L outcomes.

2. GenAI ROI Validation: Directly correlates LLM token consumption costs against business value generated per department (Customer Service, Marketing, Engineering), preventing unmonitored AI budget inflation.

3. Strategic Commitment Hedging: Optimizes 1-year and 3-year Flexible Committed Use Discounts (CUDs) to maximize enterprise discount tiers while retaining multi-cloud workload flexibility.
